Name: All-Day Elixirs
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
All-Day Elixirs
Tired of drinking the same Elixir repeatedly because its buff expires too quickly?
[b]All-Day Elixirs[/b] is a simple, lightweight Stardew Valley QoL mod that makes your Elixir buffs last for the [b]entire in-game day[/b]. Drink an Elixir once, and its existing effects remain active until you go to sleep.
No new items, complicated mechanics, or unnecessary changes—just longer-lasting Elixir buffs.
[heading]✨ Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]🧪 [b]Elixir buffs last all day[/b] [/*]
[*]🌙 Buffs expire normally when the day ends [/*]
[*]🔄 No need to repeatedly consume the same Elixir [/*]
[*]🎯 [b]Elixirs only[/b] — normal food and drinks are unaffected [/*]
[*]✅ Keeps the Elixir's original effects [/*]
[*]⚡ Lightweight and focused on one purpose [/*]
[*]🔧 Works as a standalone SMAPI mod [/*]
[*]🚫 No new items or recipes [/*]
[*]🚫 No permanent buffs across days [/*]
[/list][heading]🧪 How It Works[/heading]
Simply consume an Elixir as you normally would.
Instead of the buff lasting for its standard duration, the buff remains active until the current day ends.
For example:
[b]Vanilla:[/b]
[quote]Drink Elixir → buff expires after its normal duration → drink another Elixir[/quote][b]With All-Day Elixirs:[/b]
[quote]Drink Elixir → buff remains active → sleep → buff ends[/quote]You still need to consume the Elixir again on the following day.
[heading]🎮 Gameplay[/heading]
The mod does [b]not[/b] change what an Elixir does. Its effects, stats, item, recipe, price, and availability remain unchanged.
Only the [b]duration[/b] of the resulting buff is modified.
This means you can spend an entire day mining, fighting, exploring, or performing other activities without having to constantly watch your Elixir timer.
[heading]⚙️ Compatibility & Scope[/heading]
All-Day Elixirs is designed to stay intentionally simple.
The mod does not modify:
[list]
[*]Normal food buffs [/*]
[*]Coffee or other drinks [/*]
[*]Alcoholic beverages [/*]
[*]Permanent player effects [/*]
[*]Elixir recipes or prices [/*]
[*]Elixir item properties [/*]
[*]Unrelated buffs [/*]
[/list]The goal is to provide [b]one specific QoL improvement: all-day Elixir buffs.[/b]
[heading]📦 Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/b] [/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.1 or later[/b] [/*]
[/list]No Content Patcher or additional framework is required.
[heading]📥 Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Download [b]All-Day Elixirs[/b]. [/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]AllDayElixirs[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Drink an Elixir and enjoy its effects for the rest of the day.[/*]
[/list]Thanks as well to everyone who downloads, tests, reports bugs, and provides feedback.
[b]Drink once. Buff all day.[/b]
